changes.balance: ~275 kb/d of WCS demand still offline — the diff stays pressured until full rates.
changes.body: Several units at the ~275 kb/d Illinois refinery returned Wednesday (Quantum Commodity Intelligence, Sep 24) — but there is no company-confirmed full restart. Offline = Western Canadian Select (WCS) wider and weaker; units returning = tightening in anticipation; a confirmed full restart = the snap tighter for Nov/Dec.
changes.title: Joliet partial restart only

changes.balance: Spare takeaway −38 kb/d m/m against record Q4 supply — widening-risk bias into winter.
changes.body: Carry-forward June 2026 data: Keystone ~94%, Trans Mountain ~96%, Enbridge Mainline ~94% of available capacity. Spare takeaway down from ~310 kb/d in May. Oil Sands Magazine (Sep 22) puts Q4 basin production at a record 4.8 MMb/d.
changes.title: Egress functionally full

changes.balance: ~300 kb/d of synthetic supply offline plus record distillate cracks — doubly supportive for SCO/WCS relative value.
changes.body: Back ~mid-October. Horizon essentially fully offline for the 35-day turnaround — roughly 300 kb/d of synthetic crude out. (Canadian Natural's 29 kb/d figure is the annual-average guidance impact, not the daily outage.) Synthetic-supportive vs WCS while down. Second leg: distillate cracks at all-time records — ULSD crack ~$106–108/bbl early September (first prints ever above $100; normal $20–30), heating oil crack $117/bbl Sep 10. Distillate-rich synthetic crude is the prime beneficiary — double support for SCO relative value alongside the outage.
changes.title: Horizon upgrader ~day 19 of 35

changes.balance: Financial positioning, not physical barrels — but the only public window into speculative pressure on the WCSB's own paper.
changes.body: Managed money net short the ICE WCS 1A differential by ~19,735 contracts — 1.8σ below the 52-week mean, an extreme print. Net long Houston +12,298 (z +0.8, not extreme).
changes.title: WCS paper: specs short the 1A
changes.vintage: CFTC data as of Tue Sep 22, released Fri Sep 25

changes.balance: Directional: a below-normal PADD 2 is supportive for WCSB barrels clearing east.
changes.body: Petroleum Administration for Defense District (PADD) 2 crude stocks sit below the 5-year seasonal norm for this week — the WCSB's refining backyard is not long crude.
changes.title: PADD 2 stocks below seasonal

changes.balance: Watch-only near term; structural for 2027 egress.
changes.body: The next catalyst is the Canada Energy Regulator approval deadline Trans Mountain requested — Oct 1, for Jan 1, 2027 implementation (firm share 80% → 90%).
changes.title: TMX toll catalyst Oct 1

changes.balance: Watch-only for WCSB barrels; directional support for heavy barrels via global product markets.
changes.body: LUKOIL's ~252 kb/d Perm refinery (Russia's 7th-largest) halted operations after the overnight Sep 24/25 strike. The gasoil crack vs Brent printed a record ~$95/bbl on diesel-export-ban chatter.
changes.title: Perm refinery halt

changes.balance: Leading supply indicator — watch-only; rigs today are barrels in 6–9 months.
changes.body: Canadian oil rigs at 143, +11 week-on-week and +17 year-on-year — the rebound concentrated in heavy-oil regions (RBN Energy, Sep 25).
changes.title: Canadian rigs rebound

flags.title: US diesel export ban decision
flags.trigger: Federal ban (full/partial) announced → US distillate cracks fall, record-crack leg of SCO support breaks; voluntary cuts only → softer easing
flags.body: Trump endorsed a diesel export ban Sep 22 with a fast decision promised; current posture is voluntary refiner export cuts (no federal ban ordered). A ban traps barrels at home and crushes the cracks currently supporting synthetic crude. Watch the early-next-week plan.
flags.expires: Administration plan expected early next week — flag resolves on announcement
